mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points from the prior month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending power and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises by >0.2pp in a month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) indicates strong household demand, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are rising, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), a decline in the federal funds rate signals a preemptive monetary easing to combat economic slowdown, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% yoy and FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates robust labor market conditions, which supports consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS has increased over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 5% from the prior month signals weak residential demand, which reduces construction sector activity and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST falls by >5% in a month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates a policy response to economic weakness, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong consumer spending (RSAFS growth > 2.0% year-over-year), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a shift in demand away from residential construction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS > 2.0% yoy and HOUST declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
